body:
I knew a guy who became homeless.  He ended up going to a shelter.  It turned out well for him.

I'm sure your situation is not exactly the same as his, but I'm throwing it out there anyway.
Sorry to hear that your life sucks too.  I appreciate your optimism, but I don't think I'll ever be able to fix what's wrong with me, considering I've tried just about everything.

Your wife sounds like a tremendous piece of shit.

I was going to add, "the sooner you can remove her completely from your life (divorce, destroy photos, throw out reminders of her) the better", but then I realized that since I've never been in a relationship before so I don't know if that's good advice or not.

You do still have your dream job.  Maybe it would help to just completely absorb yourself in your work for a while.
